Question: What is your return policy?
Answer: Our return policy allows you to return any item within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. Items must be in their original condition and packaging.

Question: How do I track my order?
Answer: You can track your order by visiting our website and entering your order number in the Track Order section. You will also receive email updates with tracking information.

Question: What payment methods do you accept?
Answer: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, and bank transfers. All transactions are secured with SSL encryption.

Question: How do I reset my password?
Answer: To reset your password, click on Forgot Password on the login page and enter your registered email address. You will receive a reset link within 5 minutes.

Question: Do you offer international shipping?
Answer: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping times vary between 7 to 21 business days depending on the destination.

Question: How can I contact customer support?
Answer: You can reach our customer support team via email at support@example.com, by phone at 1-800-555-0199 Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm EST, or through the live chat on our website.

Question: Can I change or cancel my order?
Answer: Orders can be changed or cancelled within 2 hours of placement. After that, the order enters processing and changes may not be possible.

Question: What is the delivery time for standard shipping?
Answer: Standard shipping typically takes 5 to 7 business days within the continental US. Express shipping is available for 2 to 3 business day delivery.

Question: Do you have a loyalty rewards program?
Answer: Yes! Our rewards program lets you earn 1 point for every dollar spent. Points can be redeemed for discounts on future purchases. Sign up is free.

Question: Is my personal data safe with you?
Answer: We take data privacy very seriously. All personal data is encrypted and stored securely. We never sell your information to third parties. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

Question: How do I apply a discount coupon?
Answer: During checkout, you will find a Coupon Code field. Enter your code and click Apply to see the discount reflected in your order total.

Question: What happens if I receive a damaged item?
Answer: If you receive a damaged or defective item, please contact us within 48 hours with a photo of the damage. We will arrange a free replacement or full refund immediately.

Question: Can I return a sale item?
Answer: Sale items are eligible for store credit only, not cash refunds. The standard 30-day return window applies.

Question: How do I update my billing address?
Answer: Log into your account, go to Account Settings, and click on Billing Address to update your information.

Question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
Answer: Yes, gift wrapping is available for a small fee of $4.99. You can add this option and a personalized message during checkout.

Question: What is your privacy policy?
Answer: We collect only necessary data to provide our services. We use cookies for website functionality and analytics. We never share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.

Question: How do I unsubscribe from emails?
Answer: You can unsubscribe from marketing emails by clicking the Unsubscribe link at the bottom of any email, or by managing your notification preferences in your account settings.

Question: Are your products eco-friendly?
Answer: We are committed to sustainability. Many of our products are made from recycled or sustainably sourced materials. Look for the Eco-Friendly badge on product pages.

Question: Do you have a physical store?
Answer: Currently we are an online-only retailer. However, we have partnered with select retailers across the country. Visit our Store Locator page for locations near you.

Question: What sizes do you offer?
Answer: We offer sizes ranging from XS to 3XL in most clothing items. Please refer to the detailed size chart on each product page for accurate measurements.
